evals.name: backend-double-charge
evals.prompt: in shop-api (the repo at ~/code/shop-api), customers sometimes get charged twice when they retry payment after a payment gateway timeout. write me a prompt I can give claude to fix this properly
evals.expected_output: An engineered prompt grounded in real shop-api files (payment controller/service), with hypothesis-first + failing-test-first process, real verification commands from package.json, and a proof demand

evals.name: frontend-chat-lag
evals.prompt: the support chat screen in shop-web (repo at ~/code/shop-web) gets really laggy when there are lots of messages, scrolling is janky. turn this into a proper prompt for claude
evals.expected_output: An engineered prompt naming real shop-web Chat files, using the screenshot/measure-fix-remeasure loop, Playwright regression, repo styling/perf patterns (e.g. a list virtualization library present in deps)

evals.name: arch-notifications
evals.prompt: we want to move sms/email/push notifications in shop-api (repo at ~/code/shop-api) out of inline controller calls into something more reliable. how should I ask claude to design this?
evals.expected_output: A design prompt requiring 3 options with tradeoffs/failure modes grounded in the actual stack (e.g. Redis, the SMS/email/push providers in deps), steelman-against-own-pick, ADR output, no code
